summary: No stronger new unapplied 2027 opening was found today. Gmail confirms four new applications: Micron AI Innovation Research Engineer, Qualcomm Machine Learning Engineer (3089336), NVIDIA Deep Learning Libraries NCG 2026 (JR2023252), and an AMD Software Development Engineer role whose exact requisition remains uncertain. Micron is removed from Apply Now; Applied Intuition, Apple AiDP Reliability and Amazon Shenzhen remain the top three unapplied choices. NVIDIA is an exceptional technical fit but remains application history only because the official title is explicitly NCG 2026.

changes_today.reason: Exact Gmail confirmations add Micron New College Grad - AI Innovation Research Engineer, Qualcomm Machine Learning Engineer - College Graduate (3089336), and NVIDIA Software Engineer, Deep Learning Libraries - NCG 2026 (JR2023252). AMD is recorded conservatively because its confirmation omits the requisition and location.

changes_today.role: New College Grad - AI Innovation Research Engineer
changes_today.reason: Removed from Apply Now after exact application confirmation; preserved in the application tracker.

Applied Intuition, Apple, Amazon Shenzhen, Genmo, Twitch, Crusoe and Cerebras exact employer/ATS pages were rechecked on August 17 and still expose a live listing or application path. NVIDIA JR2023252 is live through at least August 18 but remains a 2026-cycle application, not a 2027 recommendation.

Daily GitHub discovery rechecked speedyapply, vanshb03, zapplyjobs, Jobright and ambicuity. The newly surfaced rows were duplicates, 2026-cycle, frontend, hardware, sponsorship-restricted or under-verified; no new adapter added distinct enough signal to justify integration.

recommendations.fit: Excellent Python/PyTorch/distributed-ML fit; physical-AI domain is adjacent rather than identical
recommendations.plausible_for_yuhan: The exact new-grad role values Python, PyTorch, computer vision/robotics systems and distributed machine-learning models. Her MS research, distributed training/inference and production AI work cover the systems half strongly.
recommendations.team_value: Multi-GPU, NCCL, model-loading and runtime optimization evidence can translate directly to scaling physical-AI training and evaluation workloads.
recommendations.why_attractive: High-pay 2027 new-grad research engineering at the infrastructure layer of a leading physical-AI company.
recommendations.new_grad: Official exact title says New Grad (2027); Ashby listing and application path are live on August 17, 2026.
recommendations.sponsorship: Not stated on the exact posting; no explicit no-sponsorship or citizenship veto found in the accessible official listing.
recommendations.urgency: Highest-priority unapplied role after today's reconciliation; apply after interview preparation.
recommendations.caveat: Computer vision/robotics evidence is weaker than MLSys evidence. Lead with distributed model systems, not old C++ contest work.

recommendations.application_limit: No published cap found; keep this as the single additional targeted Apple application.

recommendations.role: Software Development Engineer, Early Career - 2027, Device
recommendations.salary: Not listed on the official posting
recommendations.fit: Strong general distributed-systems/backend fit; less directly ML infrastructure
recommendations.plausible_for_yuhan: The official posting accepts BS-or-higher graduates from October 2026 through July 2027 and asks for one general-purpose language, data structures/algorithms and project or internship experience. Her May 2027 MS, TikTok internship, Python and NOI background meet this cleanly.
recommendations.team_value: The team builds cloud-native microservices and resilient, scalable, fault-tolerant distributed systems; her distributed-systems research, Linux debugging and production experience should transfer well.
recommendations.why_attractive: A clearly eligible 2027 SDE-I path at an elite employer in an eligible mainland-China location, with end-to-end service ownership and GenAI tooling exposure.
recommendations.new_grad: Official exact title says Early Career - 2027; job 10501875 is live on August 17 and states an October 2026-July 2027 graduation window.
recommendations.sponsorship: Mainland China is an eligible target market for Yuhan; the official posting does not state a separate work-permit restriction.
recommendations.urgency: Apply after Applied Intuition, Micron and the targeted Apple role; newly posted August 14 and now on Amazon's official graduate page.
recommendations.caveat: The 'Device' organization is software for smart-device products, not pure hardware, but it is broader backend/SDE work rather than a dedicated LLM inference team. Compensation is not listed.
recommendations.application_limit: Amazon application limits are not stated on this posting; avoid duplicative applications to near-identical China SDE roles.
